findings.title: The wrong force direction is attributed to tension instead of buoyancy
findings.quoted: 40 N richiederebbe una tensione che si aggiunge al peso verso il basso.
findings.reason: T=mg+F_A=40 N is produced by incorrectly assigning downward buoyancy while tension stays upward. With the actual directions 40+10-30=20 N upward, not equilibrium.
findings.proposedReplacement: 40 N si ottiene trattando erroneamente la spinta come una forza aggiuntiva verso il basso. In realtà tensione e spinta sono verso l’alto: T=mg−F_A=20 N.

changes.after: Il prodotto scalare è |A|·|B|cosθ. Con θ=90° il coseno è zero: il risultato si annulla anche se nessuno dei due vettori è nullo.

changes.after: Il rapporto dei moduli è positivo e non misura l’allineamento dei vettori. Il prodotto scalare dipende anche dall’angolo e qui vale zero per cos90°=0.

changes.before: B|cosθ e controlla il ruolo dell’angolo.
changes.after: Ricostruisci la formula A·B=|A|·|B|cosθ e controlla il ruolo dell’angolo.

scientificNotes: MC alternatives distinguish force threshold from actual static friction, vector velocity from speed, internal/external impulse, pressure from resultant buoyancy, and Q-fixed versus pressure-fixed Poiseuille assumptions.
Temperature/latent heat, path dependence of heat and entropy reservoir contributions are consistent with the stated models.
Lorentz no-work argument, conductor interior rather than cavity, Lenz flux direction, single-photon energetic threshold, virtual-image signs and beta-minus nuclear changes are coherent.
All ten completion answers, unit checks and worked calculations are coherent; the identified P2 affects one explanatory error hypothesis, not its numeric key or force-balance worked solution.
Radioactivity correctly marks ln2~0.7 as the prescribed approximation and distinguishes statistical expected rate from exactly observed decay count or a half-life time average.
limitations: AI independent review is not human scientific approval or learner calibration.
Selection is editorial, incomplete over the syllabus and consists of existing legacy items, not unseen psychometric items.
Official numerical normalization/grading remains unknown; this artifact implements neither a parser nor an examination session.
Some inherited prompts remain awkward or rely on ordinary model assumptions, recorded in sourceCaveat; no broad official wording conformity is certified.
Old full Lorentz solution retains its historical bad option-order reference; only the new proposed feedback is corrected.
One P2 remains open on the exact frozen hash; the proposed sentence has not been applied by this reviewer.
